chase.title: Chase
chase.moveSub: Your speed; you can still attack or cast a spell
chase.dashSave: No free dash left: a DC 10 Constitution save, or a level of exhaustion
chase.cx.urban.cart: A cart or a horse blocks the way: DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics); on a failure, 3 m of difficult terrain.
chase.cx.urban.crowd: A crowd in the street: DC 10 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics); on a failure, 3 m of difficult terrain.
chase.cx.urban.window: A window or a barrier: DC 10 Strength save to smash through; on a failure, you bounce off and fall prone.
chase.cx.urban.crates: A maze of barrels and crates: DC 10 Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Intelligence check; on a failure, 3 m of difficult terrain.
chase.cx.urban.slippery: The ground is slippery: DC 10 Dexterity save; on a failure, you fall prone.
chase.cx.urban.dogs: A pack of dogs: DC 10 Dexterity (Acrobatics); on a failure, 1d4 piercing and 1.5 m of difficult terrain.
chase.cx.urban.brawl: A brawl: DC 15 Athletics, Acrobatics or Intimidation; on a failure, 2d4 bludgeoning and 3 m of difficult terrain.
chase.cx.urban.beggar: A beggar blocks the way: DC 10 Athletics, Acrobatics or Intimidation — or toss a coin; on a failure, 1.5 m of difficult terrain.
chase.cx.urban.guard: An overzealous guard mistakes you for someone else: if you move 6 m or more, an opportunity attack +3, 1d6+1 bludgeoning.
chase.cx.urban.turn: A sharp turn: DC 10 Dexterity save; on a failure, you hit something: 1d4 bludgeoning.
chase.cx.wild.brush: A patch of brush: DC 10 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics); on a failure, 1.5 m of difficult terrain.
chase.cx.wild.uneven: Uneven ground: DC 10 Dexterity (Acrobatics); on a failure, 3 m of difficult terrain.
chase.cx.wild.insects: A swarm of insects: an opportunity attack +3, 4d4 piercing.
chase.cx.wild.stream: A stream, a ravine or a rock bed: DC 10 Athletics or Acrobatics; on a failure, 3 m of difficult terrain.
chase.cx.wild.dust: Sand, dust or snow in the eyes: DC 10 Constitution save; on a failure, blinded until the end of the turn (speed halved).
chase.cx.wild.drop: A sudden drop: DC 10 Dexterity save; on a failure, you fall 1d4 × 1.5 m (1d6 bludgeoning per 3 m) and land prone.
chase.cx.wild.snare: A hunter's snare: DC 15 Dexterity save; on a failure, you are restrained in a net (DC 10 Strength to break free).
chase.cx.wild.stampede: A stampede of animals: DC 10 Dexterity save; on a failure, 1d4 bludgeoning and 1d4 piercing.
chase.cx.wild.razorvine: Razorvine: DC 15 Dexterity save, or spend 3 m of movement to avoid it; on a failure, 1d10 slashing.
chase.cx.wild.predator: A creature of the place joins the chase: the DM chooses it.
